title: Tunnels
intro: Configure tunnel interfaces in the candidate. Live engine identities, endpoints, IPv4/IPv6 FIBs and counters come from agent readback; unavailable values remain unknown.

instance.title: Instance
instance.help: Fixes the engine interface name; required by this build and inside the agent's id range

src.title: Source address
src.help: Must be configured on an interface in the underlay VRF

underlayVrf.title: Underlay VRF
underlayVrf.help: FIB used to reach the tunnel destination

vrf.title: VRF
vrf.help: FIB the tunnel interface belongs to (overlay)

bridgeDomain.title: Bridge domain
bridgeDomain.help: L2 tunnels only: numeric id of the bridge domain

type.title: Type
type.help: l3 = IP over GRE, teb = Ethernet over GRE, erspan = ERSPAN type II

dscp.title: Outer DSCP
dscp.help: Omit to copy the inner DSCP

mcastInterface.title: Multicast interface
mcastInterface.help: Interface used to join the multicast group (multicast destination only)

decap.title: Decapsulation
decap.help: l2 bridges the inner frame; ip4/ip6 route the inner packet in the tunnel VRF

stateError: Live tunnel state could not be read. Configuration remains editable.

limits.gtpu: GTP-U forwarding drops packets by default. Enable forwarding only after validating the configured path.
limits.l2tpv3: This build cannot delete L2TPv3 tunnels. Removal or changes requiring recreation fail; cookies can update in place. Only the default underlay VRF is supported.
limits.pppoe: These entries configure PPPoE session records. Configure WAN discovery and authentication on the Interfaces page.
limits.sixrd: 6RD is configured inside IPIP. Its configured prefixes are not reported as live endpoints.
